criteria: Preserve every publisher Mass as a dated native record and archive its raw response.
Merge equivalent citations; retain different regional Scripture as language-specific options when the observance is the same.
Do not mix another observance or a higher-rank national formulary into the original calendar prayers.
Separate explicit speaker markers and structural verse markers from the daily body.
Supplement daily propers only from the identified Missal formulary and explicitly declared common.
Reject explicit wrong dates, wrong Sunday cycles, and default sources restricted to another country.
Protect edited snapshots; ordinary sentence rows, rubrics and order remain controlled by editable country datasets.

limitations.reason: The official lectionary index is blocked with HTTP 403; no text was fabricated.
The dated CEM rows for November 22-29 were not available; November 30 returned HTTP 429. CEM also prints week XXXII for some dated week XXXIII rows; the printed title and actual body are retained.
iBreviary exposes its current Roman day only; future dated lectionaries are not published from a current-day substitute.
Universalis future dates outside its public window have incomplete readings. Partial collections remain stored and unpublished.
No complete matching Hanoi source was resolved. November 29 redirects to a Sunday cycle A article although cycle B is required. KPV remains separately available.
